subject.title: [Bug]: Preflight compaction failure permanently locks Composer into "terminated" state

question: Which linked fix path should become the canonical implementation for preflight compaction failure recovery?
rationale: The issue is source-proven, but open PRs propose overlapping retryability contracts and the reporter is explicitly waiting for maintainer guidance before adding another variant.

options.title: Use the narrowed runtime guard
options.body: Treat timeout, true 429 rate limits, and 5xx preflight compaction failures as recoverable while keeping 400/401/403 and billing/request-shape cases terminal, then require real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Prefer UI lifecycle recovery
options.body: Keep compaction failure policy stricter and fix Control UI reconciliation so pre-run dispatch errors restore the Composer with an actionable retry path.

options.title: Combine runtime and UI recovery
options.body: Land the narrow transient skip and add a UI safety net if proof still shows a disabled Composer after pre-run dispatch failures.

recommendation.title: Use the narrowed runtime guard
recommendation.body: Treat timeout, true 429 rate limits, and 5xx preflight compaction failures as recoverable while keeping 400/401/403 and billing/request-shape cases terminal, then require real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue discussion already routes the retryability-contract choice to this handle, and linked PRs cite his prior guidance on the same boundary.
